sections.title: How it works
sections.content: You know *köteles* and *kénytelen* from B1 Unit 10: they say that a rule or a circumstance required someone to do something. In a history they describe what a rule required at the time, so the verb *volt* follows them: *a panaszos köteles volt kimeríteni a rendes jogorvoslatokat*. With a plural subject *köteles* takes the plural ending: *a bíróságok kötelesek voltak*. New in this lesson is the vocabulary of constitutional courts.

sections.title: Example
sections.content: Example: *2012 után az érintett köteles volt előbb kimeríteni a rendes jogorvoslatokat.*

sections.title: Patterns in Context
rows: A panaszos köteles volt kimeríteni a rendes jogorvoslatokat.
The complainant had to exhaust the ordinary legal remedies.
Az érintettek kötelesek voltak előbb kimeríteni a rendes jogorvoslatokat.
Those affected had to exhaust the ordinary legal remedies first.
A panaszos kénytelen volt előbb más jogorvoslatot igénybe venni.
The complainant had to use another legal remedy first.
